title: Сыворотка правды и чужое кольцо  (Truth Serum and Someone Else's Ring)

scenes.title: Утренний совет Марины  (Marina's Morning Advice)
scenes.summary: Denis wakes up hungover at Senya's apartment while Marina urges Sveta to trick Denis into buying an engagement ring at a fake discount.

scenes.title: Травма мамы Лёвы  (Lyova's Mother's Injury)
scenes.summary: Lyova's mother claims she fractured her leg in the bathtub and needs a month of care, but insists Lyova move back in without Gulya.

scenes.title: Таинственный букмекер  (The Mysterious Bookmaker)
scenes.summary: Barinov tries to coax a betting tip on Italian football out of a bookmaker guest, while Sveta gushes about her future with Denis.

scenes.title: Звонок из ювелирного и белладонна  (Call from the Jeweler and Belladonna)
scenes.summary: Denis receives a staged phone call offering a half-price discount on engagement rings, and Barinov orders belladonna herb from Timur to make a truth serum.

scenes.title: Странное совпадение  (A Strange Coincidence)
scenes.summary: Denis tells Kostya that he spent the night with Sveta and finds it uncanny that a jewelry store called him with a ring discount right after.

scenes.title: Подарок для Насти и переезд Лёвы  (A Gift for Nastya and Lyova's Move)
scenes.summary: Kostya asks Denis to buy an anniversary ring for Nastya using the half-price discount, while Lyova's mother keeps him from stepping outside.

scenes.title: Тайное свидание и покупка кольца  (Secret Date and Buying the Ring)
scenes.summary: Lyova runs to the pharmacy for his mother's sleeping pills, and Marina calls Sveta to report that Denis bought the engagement ring.

scenes.title: Настоящий перелом  (A Real Fracture)
scenes.summary: Gulya catches Lyova's mother faking her broken leg in the kitchen, only for his mother to fall and actually injure her leg.

scenes.title: Проверка сыворотки на Сене  (Testing the Serum on Senya)
scenes.summary: Barinov tests his belladonna truth serum on Senya in a spoonful of sauce, causing Senya to insult the chef's cooking to his face.

scenes.title: Честный Сеня и слух о свадьбе  (Honest Senya and the Wedding Rumor)
scenes.summary: Under the truth serum, Senya admits he is going to steal fresh fish, while Sveta tells Katya that Denis bought her an engagement ring.

scenes.title: Поездка на рентген и секрет Шефа  (Trip to the X-Ray and Chef's Secret)
scenes.summary: Gulya comes to take Lyova's mother for an X-ray, and Barinov shows Mikhail the belladonna truth serum he tested on Senya.

scenes.title: Подмена сыворотки  (Swapping the Serum)
scenes.summary: The bookmaker arrives for his free lunch, and while Barinov is distracted in the kitchen, Mikhail pours the truth serum into the staff meal pot.

scenes.title: Макароны по-флотски и предупреждение  (Navy-Style Pasta and a Warning)
scenes.summary: Fedya serves the truth-serum pasta to the staff, and Mikhail tells the bookmaker to feed Barinov fake football results.

scenes.title: Слухи на кухне и допрос гостя  (Kitchen Rumors and Questioning the Guest)
scenes.summary: Nikita tells Denis that Katya is jealous over the wedding rumor, Nastya and Kostya skip the spiked pasta, and Barinov questions the bookmaker.

scenes.title: Жертва Гули ради любви  (Gulya's Sacrifice for Love)
scenes.summary: Lyova and Katya skip the spiked pasta out of worry, and at the clinic Gulya tells Lyova's mother she will step aside so Lyova won't be hurt.

scenes.title: Приступ откровенности в отеле  (An Outbreak of Honesty in the Hotel)
scenes.summary: The truth serum causes the staff to blurt out embarrassing truths to Eleonora and hotel guests, while Sveta asks Denis for his jacket keys.

scenes.title: Кольцо в кармане куртки  (The Ring in the Jacket Pocket)
scenes.summary: Sveta finds Kostya's ring in Denis's jacket pocket and puts it on, while Eleonora tells Barinov that the entire staff is blurting out the truth.

scenes.title: Горькая правда для Светы  (The Bitter Truth for Sveta)
scenes.summary: Barinov learns Mikhail is in room 205 after the staff's truth-serum outburst, and Denis tells Sveta the ring in his pocket is actually for Nastya.

scenes.title: Кольцо на чужой руке и признание Михаила  (A Ring on Another Hand and Mikhail's Confession)
scenes.summary: Kostya has to show Nastya her anniversary ring while it is stuck on Sveta's finger, and a drugged Mikhail confesses his hatred and sabotage to Barinov.

scenes.title: Тайный враг и предложение руки  (A Secret Enemy and a Marriage Proposal)
scenes.summary: Mikhail reveals all the pranks he pulled on Barinov, Lyova's mother welcomes Gulya into her home, and Nikita proposes marriage to Katya.
